input: m and n are positive Number integers giving the numbers of rows and columns in an obstacle-free rectangular grid. Preconditions, including the paired numeric bounds, are not checked at runtime.
return: The Number integer count of paths from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell using only one-cell right or down moves. A single row or column has one path.
mutation_aliasing: No input writes. The rolling Array is newly allocated and not exposed. The scalar result aliases no mutable input, and the Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: The paired domain requires 1 <= m,n <= 4294967295 and binomial(m+n-2,m-1) <= 9007199254740991, interpreted mathematically rather than computed by this program. Every partial path count and addition is bounded by that final count; dimensions, indices and loop increments are also exact safe integers. NaN, infinities, fractional values and BigInt are excluded. The upper dimension bound also fits the Array length range.
complexity: O(m*n) time and O(n) auxiliary space under constant-cost safe-integer arithmetic. The first row and first column each have one path. Before each interior update, the current slot counts paths from above and the previous slot counts paths from the left; their sum replaces the current slot.
source_accounting: The complete Solution class, rolling-state allocation and initialization, loops and method wrapper belong to this standalone candidate and must be charged. There are no imported helpers or hidden source expansion; any eventual judge adapter must be charged separately.
